definitions.explanation: A tooth damaged by decay, or the hole in a tooth caused by decay.
The condition or process of teeth decaying.

examples.english: If you develop the habit of brushing your teeth from childhood, you can prevent cavities.

notes:
{虫歯|むしば} literally means "bug tooth," reflecting the old belief that cavities were caused by worms.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {虫歯|むしば}がある (to have a cavity)
- {虫歯|むしば}になる (to get a cavity)
- {虫歯|むしば}を{治|なお}す (to treat a cavity)
- {虫歯|むしば}を{予防|よぼう}する (to prevent cavities)

COLLOCATIONS:
- {虫歯|むしば}の{治療|ちりょう} (cavity treatment)
- {虫歯|むしば}{予防|よぼう} (cavity prevention)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {歯|は}: Tooth
- {歯医者|はいしゃ}: Dentist
- {歯磨|はみが}き: Tooth brushing
- {歯科|しか}: Dentistry

The medical term for tooth decay is {齲歯|うし} or {齲蝕|うしょく}, but {虫歯|むしば} is overwhelmingly more common in everyday speech.
